name: DD-13 medical assistant droid
description: The DD-13 medical assistant droid, also known as the DD-13 tripedal medical droid or simply the DD-13 medical droid, was a model of medical droid designed to install cybernetic implants. Its tri-legged design granted it stability. A DD-13 worked at the Grand Republic Medical Facility, where it assisted in fitting the grievously injured Darth Vader with his life support armor.
